definitions.explanation: A piece of playground equipment with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{滑|すべ}り{台|だい}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are playing on the slide.

examples.japanese: {滑|すべ}り{台|だい}を{滑|すべ}り{降|お}りる。
あの{公園|こうえん}には{大|おお}きな{滑|すべ}り{台|だい}がある。
examples.english: That park has a big slide.

notes:
{滑|すべ}り{台|だい} is a playground slide.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {滑|すべ}り{台|だい}を{滑|すべ}る (slide down a slide)
- {滑|すべ}り{台|だい}に{登|のぼ}る (climb up a slide)
- {滑|すべ}り{台|だい}を{滑|すべ}り{降|お}りる (slide down)

TYPES:
- ローラー{滑|すべ}り{台|だい} (roller slide - with rollers instead of smooth surface)
- {長|なが}い{滑|すべ}り{台|だい} (long slide)
- らせん{滑|すべ}り{台|だい} (spiral slide)

RELATED PLAYGROUND EQUIPMENT:
- ぶらんこ (swing)
- {砂場|すなば} (sandbox)
- シーソー (seesaw)
- {鉄棒|てつぼう} (horizontal bar)
